description:
Add file-backed persistence to SessionManager using the same JSONL format as
pi-mono (one JSON-encoded entry per line).

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts lines 775-819.

## Format

Each entry is written as: Jason.encode!(entry) <> "\n"
Loading: split file contents by "\n", Jason.decode! each non-empty line.

## Serialization

Each entry struct must round-trip through JSON. Use a "type" discriminator field:
  "message", "compaction", "branch_summary", "custom", "custom_message",
  "model_change", "label", "session_info"

Implement in SessionEntry:
  to_json/1   :: (SessionEntry.t()) -> map()
  from_json/1 :: (map()) -> SessionEntry.t()

The message field of MessageEntry contains polymorphic AI message structs
(User/Assistant/ToolResult). Include a "role" discriminator in their JSON
serialization: "user", "assistant", "tool_result".

## Deferred first write (matches pi-mono behavior)

DO NOT create the file when session_manager is initialized. Buffer entries in
memory. Write the full buffer to disk the first time a MessageEntry wrapping an
%Assistant{} message is appended. After that initial flush, append incrementally
(one JSONL line per new entry).

This prevents creating session files for empty or aborted sessions.

## Changes to SessionManager

Add session_file field to the struct (default nil).

new/1 opts: add session_file: path option (stores path, does not open file).
new_from_file/1 :: (path) -> {:ok, SessionManager.t()} | {:error, reason}
  — reads file, decodes each line, rebuilds entries + by_id + leaf_id

Internal persist_entry/2: called after every append_* when session_file is set
and the initial-flush condition has been met.

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/session_manager_persistence_test.exs.
Use System.tmp_dir! for temp files; clean up in on_exit.
  - No file created until first Assistant MessageEntry appended
  - Full buffer written on first Assistant message
  - Subsequent entries appended as single lines
  - new_from_file/1 round-trips all entry types
  - MessageEntry with User/Assistant/ToolResult all round-trip correctly
title: JSONL persistence in SessionManager
